Which statement best describes the Three Lines Model in governance?
column4: Business units own risk, risk and compliance functions support and challenge, internal audit provides independent assurance
column6: Risk management is solely an IT responsibility
column8: The Three Lines Model assigns risk ownership to the first line, support and challenge to the second line, and independent assurance to internal audit.

column2: A vendor will host customer personal data and support a revenue-critical process with no ready substitute. How should inherent risk be tiered?
column3: Low risk because the contract value is small
column4: Low risk once an NDA is signed
column5: High risk due to sensitive data access, service criticality and low substitutability
column6: No tiering needed until an incident occurs
column8: Inherent-risk tiering reflects data sensitivity, criticality of the service and substitutability — not price, paperwork or incident history.

column2: Under ISO/IEC 27001:2022, what must the Statement of Applicability document?
column3: Every employee salary band and office seating plan
column4: Which Annex A controls apply or are excluded with justification and implementation status
column5: Customer data published for transparency purposes
column6: A blanket deletion of all logs after 24 hours
column8: The SoA is a mandatory artefact mapping each Annex A control to in or out of scope with justification plus how applied controls are implemented.
